research_questions: Which duration (1m, 3m, 5m, 10m or sub-3m) best balances F1, Recall, Baseline FPR, and waiting latency?
Is longer calibration always better, or does it hit diminishing returns / overfit to early transients?
Does calibration reduce worst-case participant failures as well as average performance?
Do WESAD and PhysioNet show consistent trends across calibration lengths?
